A table with a separator row:

| Column A | Column B |
| --- | --- |
| one | two |
| **bold** | `code` |

A table with no separator row:

| Only | Header |
| x | y |

A table with alignment markers:

| Left | Right |
|:--- | ---:|
| 1 | 2 |

A table immediately after a bullet list:

- bullet before table
| H1 | H2 |
| --- | --- |
| a | b |
